gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with an e that gapes open like a pried clasp. And Amadeus, stretched wide with upright round letters, supplies the loudest contrast to that sturdy body.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-pridi: Proud, almost capital-sized small letters give this serif a classic, refined voice. Pridi is happy at modest sizes, while Amadeus, with its neon-glass tube stroke, stays the commanding voice.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-scope-one: Refined and traditional, Scope One has stubby ascenders under a big x-height. Amadeus stretches wide above it, drawn with one constant-width pen line, and that bold, steady line against the classic serif is what stays in memory.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-slabo-13px: Amadeus stretches its words wide, with a stylus-at-fixed-pressure stroke that feels bold and commanding. And Slabo 13px, bookish and dignified, keeps large, open counters in its tall letters, so pages of text would go down smoothly.
gen-dafont-amadeus-gf-suwannaphum: This serif reads dignified and editorial, its c open like a bent paperclip. Suwannaphum holds the text while Amadeus, with constant-width arms and legs, spreads wide and commands the top of the page.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-domine: Azonix draws every vertical and horizontal stroke at identical weight, in wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk. Domine loosens that rigidity below with tapered, glass-rod strokes and breathing curves.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-esteban: Esteban is a refined serif with oversized lowercase and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed, its strokes tapering like glass rods. Azonix, with joints that never thin or bulge, is the sharp counterweight.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-faustina: Bowls thin gracefully here, and the open-jawed c grips like a pair of pliers in this classic serif. Faustina holds the paragraphs while Azonix, with no swelling in its bowls, earns its keep big and short.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-halant: Halant is a traditional serif with a faint thick-thin shift, like a worn wooden stamp, and a towering x-height. While Azonix lays down a plain stripe of constant ink for bold statements, Halant handles the quieter texture.
gen-dafont-azonix-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Azonix draws its letters like bent straw, commanding and authoritative. Hedvig Letters Serif does the opposite, giving open-ended curves, modest stress and a tall, sturdy body room to breathe across long text.
